name: video_magic_cut
description: Joins clips and GENERATES the frames across each join, so the cut blends instead of jumping. `zones` marks the parts of a clip to CUT OUT; everything outside them is kept and stitched. A plain butt-joint with no generated frames is `video_concatenate`, which is free. Requires a paid plan. Then `creations_show`.

clips.description: Clips to stitch, in the order they should play.

zones.description: Parts of this clip to REMOVE. What is left over is what gets stitched. Omit to keep the whole clip.

contextFrames.description: Frames of existing footage the blender reads on each side of a join. Default 12.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

newFrames.description: Extra frames invented at the join, lengthening the result. Default 0.

replaceFrames.description: Frames of existing footage it overwrites at the join. Default 12.

seams.description: Per-join overrides. Omit to apply the same three values to every join.

at.description: Position of this join, in seconds of the output.
